QuestInfo.name: Educating Smart Pets (Speech by Itself)
QuestInfo.0: You have a very smart pet with you. Please take it to Bartos the pet instructor. With his guidance, the pet may even start a conversation...
QuestInfo.1: In order to request Bartos for help in teaching the evolving pet new language, I'll need to bring him his favorite drink. The drink can be obtained through merchants.
QuestInfo.2: I gave Bartos a drink and taught the evolving pet. Apparently the pet may start the conversation at times...what would it say...?

0.0: Hoh...you seem to have yourself quite an intelligent pet. Did you bring it here for my training? Pets need to be trained and educated...and of course, once I do that, the pet will become that much more special. It'll even learn to talk by itself. What do you think? Do you want me to help you out?

yes.0: Okay, good decision. You should also know that there's nothing's that's free. If you train others as much as I do, you tend to get a bit thirsty. Can you get me a drink? I have this drink that I really love, so much so that the merchants know exactly what I want. I'll be waiting.

no.0: Fine. Let me know if you ever change your mind.

1.0: Did you bring the drink? Ahhh...just thinking about drinking this already puts me in a much better mood. Okay, now shall we start the session?

yes.0: Hey what do you think? That was fast, wasn't it? Marvel at my awesome training skills... and now, your pet will be that much more intelligent than before.

item.0: What? You didn't bring the drinks yet? I am thirsty... and I can't teach without the drink.
